baselineProtocol.turnRateEstimator: OLS unwrapped velocity direction; CV fallback if any history speed < 0.5 m/s
baselineProtocol.selection: Fixed exploratory settings; not tuned by city

limitations: No trained interaction model or held-out performance claim.
Groups are manually assigned: overlapping acquisition sessions must share a group.
ADE excludes anchor and averages future 100 ms points; FDE is endpoint distance.
Motion stratification uses anchor speed only; low_speed is not a stationary-event label.
Risk reviews are not accident ground truth.
futureMotion uses future endpoint velocity for retrospective diagnosis only, never model input. Net direction change is not a map-confirmed turning maneuver.
Each city has one public sample recording: city and recording effects cannot be separated.
